name: d9c
description: Manage containers on saved Docker, Podman, nerdctl and CRI-O hosts through the d9c CLI and MCP server, with a read-only default and explicit write policy.

host.title: d9c host
host.description: Saved d9c host the MCP server connects to (see `d9c hosts ls`). Leave empty to use DOCKER_HOST, the Docker context or the local socket.
